sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The bar chart below gives information about the number of students studying Computer Science at a UK university between 2010 and 2012. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
Some physiologists recommend that it is important to overcome stresses by spending time do nothing. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
